department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India; implemented for eligible farmers in MP
beneficiary: Landholding farmer families meeting the scheme rules
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments, transferred directly to eligible beneficiaries' bank accounts.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families as per PM-KISAN guidelines. Exclusion categories include institutional landholders, certain constitutional/public office holders, specified government employees/pensioners, income-tax payers and practicing registered professionals, subject to the official rules.
required_documents: Aadhaar and relevant farmer/bank/land details as required during registration and verification.
application_process: New Farmer Registration is available on the official PM-KISAN portal; eKYC is mandatory for registered farmers.
application_fee: Not specified as a fee on the official portal.
source_type: Government of India PM-KISAN portal + MP Government CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
verification_note: Official PM-KISAN portal and MP Government scheme dashboard were checked.
